criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Identical oblique isometric projection and diamond-aligned ground axes.
World crop, yaw, pitch, elevation, and landmark placement coincide.
different: No visible camera or framing difference.

evidence.observation: Oblique city framing runs from the left industrial zone to the dense right district.
The same projection, crop, horizonless elevation, and diagonal axes are preserved.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: The dense residential mass on the right and industrial clusters on the left match exactly.
Open corridors, roads, buildings, and occupied-map distribution coincide.
different: No visible density or mass-distribution difference.

evidence.observation: Sparse industrial terrain transitions into a tightly occupied residential district.
Building count, spacing, road coverage, and open-ground pockets visibly match.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: The dark, dry channel follows the same bends through the left and central terrain.
Bank depth, exposed bed, crossings, and heat-state lack of reflections match.
different: No visible channel-geometry or attachment difference.

evidence.observation: A recessed, winding dry channel cuts through the cracked industrial terrain.
The channel curvature, banks, bed texture, and crossings occupy identical positions.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Plants, pylons, substations, hospital, and water tower retain identical relative sizes.
Facility silhouettes and their spacing against nearby houses match.
different: No visible landmark-scale or silhouette difference.

evidence.observation: Large plants anchor the left while pylons, substations, hospital, and water tower establish scale.
Every major facility and grid landmark has the same silhouette size and placement.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Blackened metal, cracked soil, concrete, and sepia midtones are identical.
Amber heat lighting and cyan electrical bloom have the same cohesion and intensity.
different: No visible material, lighting, or surface-detail difference.

evidence.observation: Dark iron structures sit over detailed cracked earth under strong amber sunlight.
The same metal patina, ground relief, warm grading, shadows, and glow are present.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Cyan conductors, white energized segments, and the short amber overload segment follow identical routes.
Tower attachments, substation connections, and route readability coincide.
different: No visible energized/planned distinction or attachment difference.

evidence.observation: A readable cyan-white route links the plants, towers, and right-side substation, with one amber segment.
Conductor colors, bends, tower junctions, capacity tag, and coverage ring match exactly.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: The same black industrial chrome frames the top rail, left kit, right inspector, and footer.
Overlay ratio, inspector hierarchy, map integration, and cyan/orange emphasis match.
different: English labels become Korean labels, and footer glyph content changes without altering HUD geometry.

evidence.observation: Heavy iron panels occupy matching top, left, right, and bottom screen edges.
Panel footprints, borders, inset construction, selection glow, and information hierarchy remain fixed.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both visibly read as the same +8°C heatwave state with harsh sun and parched amber terrain.
The same outage warning, 6% condition, unavailable pylon, and stressed grid are shown.
different: Only the language of state labels changes.

evidence.observation: HEAT +8°C, intense sun, cracked ground, warning marker, and unavailable inspector establish the heat outage.
The identical world effects and failure indicators persist, with localized state text.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both strips use the same centered footprint, four-part iron chrome, and cyan-selected second segment.
Icon-first cells, inset borders, restrained color hierarchy, and HUD integration match.
different: The candidate substitutes labeled event stages and an orange result warning for playback glyphs and speed numerals.

evidence.observation: A centered four-cell playback strip has the second cell selected in cyan.
A distinct four-stage event bar clearly shows briefing, active heat stage, outage result, and next, with the second stage selected.
